tools.description: Teacher-force base/current on up to 16 raw texts, <=32768 tokens each and <=131072 tokens total. Module name is its tensor name without .weight. Artifact: texts entries have text,tokens,positions,hidden (layers x positions x width),modules (name -> input/output arrays),top_ids,top_logprobs,next_ids,next_logprobs. One forward-budget unit.
